title: Archive the stale 993-line root coding-standards.md superseded by docs/coding-standards.md

evidence.quote:
// REQUIRED - Always UTC
final now = DateTime.now().toUtc();

why: Two documents claim to be the coding-standards authority. The root one (993 lines, older) actively contradicts the canonical docs/coding-standards.md — e.g. it REQUIRES `DateTime.now().toUtc()` while audit check 6 bans `DateTime.now()` outside core/time entirely. An agent that greps for coding-standards can land on the wrong file and follow dead rules; a doc that lies is worse than no doc.
recommendation: Move root coding-standards.md to docs/_archive/ (or delete it) and leave nothing at the root but a pointer; sweep other root-level docs for the same staleness.
acceptance_criteria: root coding-standards.md gone or replaced by a one-line pointer to docs/coding-standards.md
doc-lint/audit grep asserting only one file named coding-standards.md exists outside _archive

corrections: Evidence undersells it: README.md:117, docs/index.md:100 ('enforced coding rules'), and docs/developer-handbook.md:354 all live-link to the STALE root file as canonical — this isn't a dead orphan, it's the file agents following documented links actually land on.
